name: ZINC-12k
description: A molecular graph regression benchmark containing 12,000 drug-like molecules sampled from the ZINC database. The task is to predict penalized logP from molecular structure.
citation: Dwivedi, V. P., Joshi, C. K., Laurent, T., Bengio, Y., & Bresson, X. (2020). Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks. arXiv:2003.00982. https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.00982
